inlines.v: COMMISERATE, verb transitive 1. To pity; to compassionate; to feel sorrow, pain or regret for another in distress; applied to persons. We should commiserate those who groan beneath the weight of age, disease or want. 2. To regret; to pity; to be sorry for; as, to commiserate our mutual ignorance.
